evidence.V1: Front and three-quarter read instantly as a bookcase (frame, 3 shelves, books); silhouette has crown cap and feet, symmetric outline.
evidence.V2: Clear hierarchy: frame/cap (big), shelves and book groups (medium), gold spine bands (small).
evidence.V3: Books are uniform boxes of near-identical size, evenly stood, and the frame is a straight box; reads tidy but stiff rather than stylised (no lean, no varied heights/thickness).
evidence.V4: Consistent chamfers on cap, posts, shelves and book edges (close_top, close_books).
evidence.V5: Close-ups of books, plinth and top are clean; no pinches, seams or z-fighting.
evidence.V6: Wood browns in 3 values + book hue in 3 values + cream + gold accent; colourways swap the book hue cleanly.
evidence.V8: Vertex-colour single material, frame wood + fabric book hue, gold fittings, cream: matches kit rules.
evidence.V9: Studio line: Anchored, Box collision, CanTouch off, white MeshPart, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre; all gates pass.

top_fixes: Vary book heights/thickness and lean or topple one or two books to add stylised character
Add a small prop (ink bookend, scroll) or slight cap overhang profile for more exaggeration
